# Wispr Flow

> > The fastest voice-to-text tool for Mac, Windows, iPhone, and Android with AI editing, enterprise security, and seamless integrations.

Wispr Flow is a cross-platform voice dictation platform that enables hands-free productivity through advanced speech-to-text technology. The product serves diverse user segments including developers, business leaders, lawyers, students, and accessibility users, with enterprise-grade security compliance (SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, ISO 27001) and integrations with popular tools like Notion, Gmail, Google Docs, Cursor, and Slack.
